
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hackernb/p/19692906" title="发布于 2026-03-09 19:52">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">白帽子为什么几乎都绕不开 httpx：一款 HTTP 资产探测工具的技术价值</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>如果你平时做的是 Web 渗透、SRC 挖洞、红蓝对抗里的前期侦察，或者应急里的暴露面排查，那你大概率绕不开 httpx这款工具的。</span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>我说的不是 Python 那个 HTTPX 客户端，而是&nbsp;<span><strong>ProjectDiscovery 出的 httpx</strong><span>。官方对它的定义很直接：<span><strong><br></strong></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="objectivec"><code><span>一个高性能、面向多探针的 HTTP 工具包支持高并发下对 URL、主机、<span class="code-snippet__built_in">CIDR&nbsp;等</span></span></code><code><span>目标做 HTTP 层探测，并尽量保证结果稳定性。</span></code><code><span>它本质上不是漏洞扫描器，而是 Web 资产探测和结果归一化工具。</span></code></pre>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><strong>工具地址链接：</strong></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="javascript"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attr">https:<span class="code-snippet__comment">//github.com/projectdiscovery/httpx</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><img alt="686eb8943ac9b20f06e095e0a4a3d5b2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2318014/202603/2318014-20260309195000979-1891599857.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">很多人第一次接触它，会把它理解成"批量访问网页的工具"。这么理解不算错，但太浅了。<code>httpx</code>&nbsp;真正厉害的地方，不在于"能不能访问"，而在于它能把一堆杂乱的目标，快速整理成一批<strong>有上下文、有指纹、有优先级</strong>的 Web 资产结果。</span></p>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>它不是用来打的，而是用来筛的</span></h2>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>白帽子做信息收集时，经常会遇到一个问题：<span><span><br></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang=""><code><span>目标很多，子域很多，端口很多，URL 更多，但真正值得深挖的点很少。</span></code></pre>
<p><span>这个时候，<span><code>httpx</code><span>&nbsp;的价值就出来了。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span>它可以在探测时顺手拿到很多 HTTP 层信息，比如:</span></p>
<p><span><span>状态码、标题、内容长度、重定向位置、响应时间、favicon hash、JARM、IP、CNAME、ASN、<span class="wx_search_keyword_wrap">CDN/WAF、TLS 证书信息、CSP 信息、Web 技术栈等。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span>也就是说，<span><code>httpx</code><span>&nbsp;干的不是“找到漏洞”，而是先回<span>答这些问题：</span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="swift"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">1.这个域名到底活不活；</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">2.它跑的是不是&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">Web&nbsp;服务；</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">3.是&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">HTTP&nbsp;还是&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">HTTPS；</span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">4.是不是走了&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">CDN；</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">5.是不是同一套站群；</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">6.标题像不像后台；</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">7.favicon 能不能聚类；</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">8.技术栈是不是&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">PHP<span class="code-snippet__regexp">/Java/<span class="code-snippet__type">Node<span class="code-snippet__operator">/<span class="code-snippet__type">Go；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">9.证书里有没有暴露别的域名；</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">10.某批资产里哪些优先级更高</span></span></code><code><span>这一步做好了，后面的&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">Burp<span class="code-snippet__operator">、<span class="code-snippet__type">Nuclei<span class="code-snippet__operator">、<span class="code-snippet__type">Katana<span class="code-snippet__operator">、手工验证，效率会完全不一样<span class="code-snippet__operator">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>从技术上看，httpx 强在多探针并发探测</span></h2>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><code><span>httpx</span></code><span><span>&nbsp;的核心思路不是只发一个请求拿个状态码，而是围绕目标执行多种 probe。官方文档里把 probe 描述成一组针对 Web 服务器、URL 或其他 HTTP 元素的检查项。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>拿最常见的几类来说：</span></p>
<p><span>1. 基础存活与协议识别</span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>最基础的是判断目标是否可达。<span><span>但它不是傻扫。默认情况下，如果 HTTPS 不通，它会回落到 HTTP；如果你想同时保留 HTTP 和 HTTPS 的结果，可以用&nbsp;<span><code><span>-no-fallback</span></code><span>。官方还支持自定义端口和协议映射，比如把 443 按 HTTP 跑，或者把 8443 按 HTTPS 跑。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>这在实战里很有用。因为很多历史资产、非标端口、运维临时服务，协议和端口经常不规范，单靠"443=HTTPS、80=HTTP"的思路很容易漏。</span></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>2. 页面特征提取</span></h3>
<p><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;很适合做页面画像。状态码、标题、Server、content-type、响应时间、body 预览、内容长度、词数、行数，这些都是常见输出。</span></span></p>
<p><span>对测试人员来说，这些信息不是"展示用的"，而是拿来做判断的：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>302 到<span class="wx_search_keyword_wrap">单点登录，说明可能是统一认证入口</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>401/403 的资产未必没价值，反而可能是后台</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>标题里带&nbsp;<span><code><span>test</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>dev</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>admin</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>swagger</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>api</span></code><span>，优先级就上来了</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>一批长度、标题、hash 都高度相似的站，很可能是同一套模板页</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>3. 指纹与聚类能力</span></h3>
<p><span>很多人喜欢它，就是因为它非常适合"站群归类"。</span></p>
<p><span>官方支持&nbsp;<span><code><span>-favicon</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-jarm</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-tech-detect</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-asn</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-cdn</span></code><span>&nbsp;等能力。<span><code><span>-tech-detect</span></code><span>&nbsp;基于 Wappalyzer 数据做技术识别；<span><code><span>favicon</span></code><span>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<span><code><span>JARM</span></code><span>&nbsp;更适合做相似资产聚类；ASN、IP、CNAME、CDN 能帮助你判断资产归属和部署形态。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>这在 SRC 场景尤其好用。<span><span>你手里可能有几千个子域，真正要优先看的，不一定是首页最正常的那个，而是 favicon 和某个已知后台一致、JARM 相似、标题异常、技术栈可打的那一批。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>4. 路径、端口和扩展探测</span></h3>
<p><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;不是只能打一层首页。官方支持&nbsp;<span><code><span>-path</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-ports</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-vhost</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-http2</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-pipeline</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-tls-probe</span></code><span>、<span><code><span>-csp-probe</span></code><span>&nbsp;等能力，不过官方也特别提醒，这类参数更适合按场景单独使用，而不是默认全开。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>这里面有几个很实战：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="bash"><code><span>-path &nbsp;：对一批目标统一探测某些路径，比如 :</span></code><code><span>/login</span></code><code><span>/admin</span></code><code><span>/actuator</span></code><code><span>/swagger-ui</span></code></pre>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="diff"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__deletion">-ports</span></span></code><code><span>：补扫非标 Web 端口</span></code></pre>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="diff"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__deletion">-vhost</span></span></code><code><span>：适合碰虚拟主机场景</span></code></pre>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="diff"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__deletion">-tls-probe</span></span></code><code><span>：从证书侧面扩展目标面</span></code></pre>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="diff"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__deletion">-csp-probe</span></span></code><code><span>：从 CSP 中拿到更多相关域名线索</span></code></pre>
<p><span>说白了，它不是一个"只读首页"的工具，而是一个能围绕 HTTP 面持续做扩展侦察的工具。</span></p>
<h3><span>5. 过滤、匹配和去噪</span></h3>
<p><span>这个点经常被低估，但实际很关键。</span></p>
<p><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span><span>&nbsp;官方支持字符串、正则、状态码、长度、词数、行数、错误页、重复结果等多种过滤与匹配方式，还支持 <span class="wx_search_keyword_wrap">DSL。并且提供了&nbsp;<span><code><span>-filter-error-page</span></code><span>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<span><code><span>-filter-duplicates</span></code><span>&nbsp;这类非常贴近实战的参数。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>真正跑过大规模资产的人都知道，噪声远比目标多。<span><span>统一 404、WAF 拦截页、空白页、跳转页、静态占位页，这些都会淹没有效目标<span><code><span><br></span></code></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;的强点之一，就是可以把一堆"看起来都活着"的页面，进一步压缩成"值得花时间看的页面"。</span></span></p>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>为什么它总是出现在 ProjectDiscovery 工具链里</span></h2>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>官方 Quick Start 给的链路很典型：先做资产发现，再交给&nbsp;<span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;做活性确认和信息提取，然后再把结果喂给&nbsp;<span><code><span>nuclei</span></code><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>这套思路背后其实很清楚：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><code><span>subfinder</span></code><span>&nbsp;解决"有什么域名"</span></span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span><code><span>naabu</span></code><span>&nbsp;解决"开什么端口"</span></span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;解决"哪些是有价值的 HTTP 面"</span></span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span><code><span>katana</span></code><span>&nbsp;解决"往里爬能爬出什么路径"</span></span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span><code><span>nuclei</span></code><span>&nbsp;解决"基于模板能打出什么问题"</span></span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<p><span>所以&nbsp;<span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;的位置非常像一个中间层。<span><span>它上接资产发现，下接漏洞验证和手工测试。这个位置决定了它不一定最“炫”，但很可能是你用得最频繁的一个工具。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><span>对白帽子来说，它最实用的几个场景</span></h2>
<h3><span>1. 渗透测试里的资产梳理</span></h3>
<p><span>拿到一批域名、IP、端口之后，第一步不是马上扫漏洞，而是先知道哪些目标真正值得投入时间。<span><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;可以很快帮你筛出在线 Web 资产、登录页、跳转链、测试系统、接口页、后台和异常标题页。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>2. SRC 里的批量筛点</span></h3>
<p><span>SRC 最怕的是资产太多，眼睛不够用。<span><span>这时候&nbsp;<span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;不只是"探活工具"，而是一个分类器。你可以按标题、状态码、favicon、技术栈、错误页过滤，把真正值得手工看的目标提出来。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>3. 攻防演练里的快速建图</span></h3>
<p><span>演练讲究时间效率。<span><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;的高并发、多输入模式、结构化输出和批量路径探测，很适合前期快速拉一张 Web 暴露面图，再往下交给人工验证或其他模块。官方也支持 CIDR、主机、URL 等多种输入。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>4. 应急响应里的暴露面复核</span></h3>
<p><span>应急里经常需要回答这种问题：<span><span>哪些站还在线？哪些页面被篡改了？哪些后台还暴露着？哪些资产看起来是同一批？<span><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;的截图、渲染 DOM、标题、hash、favicon、证书、JARM 这些能力，就很适合做批量复核。官方文档里也提到&nbsp;<span><code><span>-screenshot</span></code><span>&nbsp;可以抓页面截图，并在搭配&nbsp;<span><code><span>-json</span></code><span>&nbsp;时把渲染后的 DOM 一起写进结果。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><span>它还有一个优点：特别适合自动化</span></h2>
<p><span>官方支持 JSONL、CSV、响应保存，还能作为 Go library 使用；另外还有 GitHub Action 可以跑周期化任务。</span></p>
<p><span>这意味着它不只是手工命令行工具，也适合塞进你自己的巡检脚本、资产监控链路、日报任务或者持续验证流程里。<span><span>对于团队化作业来说，这一点其实很重要：<span><span>不是每个工具都能自然接入流水线，但&nbsp;<span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;很适合。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><span>但也别把它神化</span></h2>
<p><span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;再好用，它也不是漏洞扫描器，更不是业务逻辑测试工具。<span><span>它不负责帮你理解鉴权链，不负责登录态后的深层测试，也不替代爬虫、代理或人工分析。官方的定位始终是 HTTP probing/toolkit，而不是"自动帮你找洞"的一站式工具。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>所以更准确地说，<span><code><span>httpx</span></code><span>&nbsp;是一把"把目标面整理清楚"的刀。<span><span>它帮你节省的，不是最后那一步验证漏洞的时间，而是前面大量无效翻页、无效点击、无效筛选的时间。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>HTTPX常用命令</span></h2>
<p><span><span><span>1.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>探测单个目标</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="javascript"><code><span>httpx -u&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__attr">https:<span class="code-snippet__comment">//example.com</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>2.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>探测多个目标</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="bash"><code><span>httpx -u https://a.com https://b.com</span></code></pre>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>3.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>从文件读取目标</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>4.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>只输出存活结果，适合做清洗</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -silent</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>5.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>显示状态码和标题</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -sc -title</span></span></code></pre>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>常规信息收集：状态，标题，长度，IP</span></h2>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>1.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>显示状态码、标题、长度</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -sc -title -cl</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>2.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>再加上 Web Server</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -sc -title -cl -server</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>3.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>显示 IP</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -ip</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>4.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>显示 CNAME</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -cname</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>5.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>显示响应时间</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>端口，路径，协议：更接近实战</span></h2>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>1.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>探测多个常见 Web 端口</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="apache"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -p&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">80,<span class="code-snippet__number">443,<span class="code-snippet__number">8080,<span class="code-snippet__number">8443</span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>2.<span>探测指定路径</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>3.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>同时探测多个路径</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="bash"><code><span>httpx -l targets.txt -path /admin,/login,/manage</span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>4.<span>显示 HTTP 和 HTTPS 两种结果，不自动只保留一个</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -nf</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>5.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>自定义端口协议映射</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -ports http:<span class="code-snippet__number">80,http:<span class="code-snippet__number">8080,https:<span class="code-snippet__number">443,https:<span class="code-snippet__number">8443</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>官方文档明确说明：默认 HTTPS 不通会回退到 HTTP，-<span class="code-snippet__literal">no-fallback 可以同时显示两种探测结果，也支持像 http:<span class="code-snippet__number">443,http:<span class="code-snippet__number">80,https:<span class="code-snippet__number">8443&nbsp;这样的端口协议映射</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>1.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>跟随重定向</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>3.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>自定义 Header</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-u https://example.com -H&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"Cookie: session=abc"</span></span></span></code></pre>

<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>输出保存：给报告，脚本，自动化用</span></h2>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>1.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>输出到文件</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>2.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>以 JSONL 输出</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="css"><code><span>httpx -l targets<span class="code-snippet__selector-class">.txt&nbsp;-sc -title -<span class="code-snippet__selector-tag">td&nbsp;-json -o result<span class="code-snippet__selector-class">.json</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>3.<span>JSON 中包含响应头</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -json -irr -o result.json</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>5.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>保存响应内容到目录</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>1.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>对所有页面截图</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>2.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>使用系统 Chrome 截图</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>4.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>截图前多等 3 秒让前端渲染完</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>5.<span>截图 + 标题 + 技术栈，一次看全</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="css"><code><span>httpx -l targets<span class="code-snippet__selector-class">.txt&nbsp;-ss -title -<span class="code-snippet__selector-tag">td&nbsp;-sc</span></span></span></code></pre>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>我最常用的八条</span></h2>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="apache"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -silent</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -sc -title</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -sc -title -td -ip</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -fc&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">404,<span class="code-snippet__number">403&nbsp;-fep -fd</span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -path /admin,/login -sc -title</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -p&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">80,<span class="code-snippet__number">443,<span class="code-snippet__number">8080,<span class="code-snippet__number">8443&nbsp;-sc -title</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -json -irh -o result.json</span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">httpx&nbsp;-l targets.txt -ss -title -td</span></span></code></pre>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>几个高频联动的场景</span></h2>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>1.<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>&nbsp;子域名subfinder 的结果直接喂给 httpx</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">subfinder&nbsp;-d example.com -silent | httpx -silent</span></span></code><code><span>subfinder -d example.com -silent | httpx -silent -sc -title</span></code><code><span>subfinder -d example.com -silent | httpx -silent -sc -title -td -ip -cdn</span></code><code><span>subfinder -d example.com -silent | dnsx -silent | httpx -silent -sc -title</span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>2.<span>子域名发现 + 标题 + 技术栈</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">subfinder&nbsp;-d example.com -silent | httpx -sc -title -td</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>3.<span>端口扫描结果继续探测 Web</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">naabu&nbsp;-host example.com -silent | httpx -sc -title</span></span></code></pre>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>4.资<span>产清洗后给 nuclei</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">subfinder&nbsp;-d example.com -silent | httpx -silent | nuclei</span></span></code></pre>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>建议这样干</span></h2>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="bash"><code><span>1.先活性：-silent<br><br></span></code><code><span>2.再识别：-sc -title -td -ip<br><br></span></code><code><span>3.再清洗：-<span class="code-snippet__built_in">fc&nbsp;404,403 -fep -fd<br><br></span></span></code><code><span>4.再定向探测：-path /admin,/login<br><br></span></code><code><span>5.最后留证据：-json 或 -ss</span></code></pre>

</div>
